functionality: Date-wise / Payment-mode-wise / User-wise Collection, Branch-wise / Organization-wise Billing, Payment Transaction Report
description: One consolidated report endpoint parameterized by reportType, per instruction to prefer one endpoint over several closely-related ones - all six report types are aggregations over the same billing_master/payment tables, differing only in the GROUP BY dimension. Bill-wise Payment Details is already covered by API-065 and is not duplicated here.

reused_apis.note: Already covers 'Bill-wise payment details' - GET /api/payments?billNumber=... returns every payment against a bill.

query_parameters.reportType: enum, required - DATE_WISE_COLLECTION | PAYMENT_MODE_WISE_COLLECTION | USER_WISE_COLLECTION | BRANCH_WISE_BILLING | ORGANIZATION_WISE_BILLING | PAYMENT_TRANSACTION

validation: reportType must be one of the six enum values
DATE_WISE_COLLECTION groups payment by payment_date::date, SUM(amount_paid)
PAYMENT_MODE_WISE_COLLECTION groups payment by payment_mode (joined to payment_mode_master for display name), SUM(amount_paid)
USER_WISE_COLLECTION groups payment by created_by (joined to users), SUM(amount_paid)
BRANCH_WISE_BILLING groups billing_master by branch_id (joined to branches), SUM(total_amount), SUM(payable_amount), SUM(paid_amount), SUM(balance_amount)
ORGANIZATION_WISE_BILLING groups billing_master by patient_registrations.client_id (joined to client_organization_master), SUM(total_amount), SUM(payable_amount)
PAYMENT_TRANSACTION returns the raw payment rows (transactionReference, paymentMode, amountPaid, paymentStatus, paymentDate, billNumber) in the date range, unaggregated

errors.condition: reportType missing or not a recognized value
fromDate is after toDate, or either is missing/malformed
organizationId or branchId does not exist

notes: Net-new contract; no e2e-validation or api_contracts_test coverage exists yet. Report row shapes above are illustrative for one reportType (PAYMENT_MODE_WISE_COLLECTION) per the 'concise' instruction - the other five follow the same { reportType, fromDate, toDate, rows[] } envelope with columns matching their GROUP BY dimension, as listed in validation.
